bio: Set in a typical Hamburg location between the Holzhafen and Altona fish market, the restaurant of well-known TV chef Steffen Henssler stands amid a plethora of seafood and fishmongers. The interior is slick and smart, with a nice and lively laid-back atmosphere. The 20m-wide kitchen serves modern interpretations of sushi in many variations, as well as dishes such as teriyaki-style Faroe salmon or rump steak from the lava grill. Senior chef Werner Henssler also gets involved in the service. It is advisable to make a reservation, whether for lunch or dinner....
